name: rma_id
description: Return Merchandise Authorization identifier (PK, e.g. RMA-2026-0401)

name: order_id
description: Associated Google Store customer order (FK to customer_orders.order_id)

name: sku_id
description: Hardware device SKU undergoing RMA evaluation (FK to products_catalog.sku_id)

name: serial_number
description: Device IMEI number or hardware serial code

name: incident_date
description: Date and time when warranty return incident was logged

name: defect_category
description: Diagnostic root defect category (OLED_MICRO_FLICKER, BATTERY_CALIBRATION_DRIFT, CERAMIC_SEAL_BREACH, HAPTIC_FEEDBACK_VARIANCE)

name: defect_severity
description: Defect classification impact severity (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

name: technician_diagnostic_summary
description: Authorized repair technician diagnostic findings and observations

name: triage_status
description: Current RMA resolution stage (PENDING_TRIAGE, VERIFIED_HARDWARE_FAULT, REPLACEMENT_DISPATCHED, REFUND_CREDITED, REJECTED_CUSTOMER_DAMAGE)

name: assigned_repair_center
description: Certified European repair center handling inspection (B2X Frankfurt, CTDI Madrid, CTDI Paris)

name: refund_credit_eur
description: Processed financial compensation or Google Store goodwill voucher in Euro (€)

name: customer_sentiment
description: Assessed customer emotional sentiment during ticket escalation (SATISFIED, NEUTRAL, ANXIOUS, FRUSTRATED)
